# Safsafah (صفصافة)

> Safsafah is an Egyptian e-commerce platform specializing in authentic skincare and cosmetics products. The site supports both Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR) and delivers across Egypt's governorates.

## Site Overview

- **Domain:** https://safsafah.com
- **Languages:** Arabic (default, RTL), English
- **Category:** Beauty & Cosmetics E-commerce (distributor, not manufacturer)
- **Currency:** EGP (Egyptian Pound)
- **Market:** Egypt

## Key Pages

- **Homepage:** https://safsafah.com — Featured collections, bestsellers, top brands, categories, and curated collections
- **Catalog / Shop:** https://safsafah.com/catalog — Browse all products with filters (brand, category, price, skin type, skin concern)
- **Product Page:** https://safsafah.com/product/{slug} — Full product detail, images, description, reviews, and add-to-cart
- **Cart:** https://safsafah.com/cart — Shopping cart with quantity controls and coupon codes
- **Checkout:** https://safsafah.com/checkout — Delivery address, payment methods (COD, card, wallets), order summary
- **Brands:** https://safsafah.com/catalog (filtered by brand) — Browse all available beauty brands
- **Blog:** https://safsafah.com/blog — Beauty tips, skincare guides, and product tutorials (Glow Journal)
- **About:** https://safsafah.com/about — Who we are, vision & mission, service commitments, FAQs
- **Contact:** https://safsafah.com/contact — Customer support contact form, WhatsApp, phone, email
- **Login:** https://safsafah.com/login — Email/password or OTP login
- **Sign Up:** https://safsafah.com/signup — New account registration
- **My Account:** https://safsafah.com/account — Order history, addresses, wishlist, rewards wallet, beauty profile, settings
- **My Orders:** https://safsafah.com/orders — Track and manage past orders
- **Skin Quiz:** https://safsafah.com/quize — Personalized skin type and concern quiz for product recommendations
- **Wallet Payment:** https://safsafah.com/wallet-payment — Pay using Safsafah rewards wallet
- **Refund Policy:** https://safsafah.com/refund-policy — Return and refund conditions

## Product Categories

Safsafah carries products in the following beauty categories:
- Skincare (moisturizers, serums, cleansers, toners, masks, SPF)
- Makeup (foundation, lipstick, mascara, eyeshadow, blush, concealer)
- Haircare (shampoo, conditioner, hair masks, oils)
- Fragrance & Body (perfumes, body lotions, scrubs)
- Tools & Accessories (brushes, applicators, devices)

## Key Features

- **Authentic Products:** Products sourced from trusted suppliers and wholesalers within Egypt; packaging and expiry dates inspected before shipping
- **Beauty Profile / Skin Quiz:** Users can take a skin type quiz to receive personalized product recommendations
- **Rewards Wallet:** Loyalty points earned on purchases; 1 point = 1 EGP, redeemable at checkout
- **Wishlist:** Save products for later
- **Reviews & Ratings:** Product reviews with rating breakdown
- **Bilingual:** Full Arabic and English support with locale-based routing (`/ar/`, `/en/`)
- **Fast Delivery:** Same/next-day delivery in Cairo & Giza; 1–3 business days within Greater Cairo; 2–5 business days for other Egyptian governorates
- **Cash on Delivery:** COD available, plus card and wallet payment options via courier
- **Free Shipping:** Free shipping on orders above 2,000 EGP; standard shipping fee of 50 EGP otherwise

## Common User Actions

- Search and filter products by brand, category, skin type, skin concern, or price
- Add products to cart and proceed to checkout
- Apply coupon codes (e.g., GLOW10 for 10% off first order)
- Select delivery address for Egyptian governorates
- Pay via cash on delivery, card, or Safsafah wallet
- Track existing orders
- Save items to wishlist
- Write and read product reviews
- Take the skin quiz for personalized recommendations
- Contact support via WhatsApp, phone, or email

## Service Commitments

- **Delivery:** To most Egyptian governorates via shipping partners; timeframes vary by courier and location
- **Payment:** Cash on delivery, card, or available wallets depending on the courier; transactions processed through certified payment channels
- **Returns:** Accepted within 14 days for unopened products per conditions on the refund policy page
- **Support:** Response during official working hours; post-purchase and delivery requests prioritized
